_comment: Plan 754.2 (2026-08-04). The `hive` server is deliberately ABSENT: it now comes from the installed plugin hive-channel@wonderforge instead, beside the plugin's `hive-local` channel helper (plan 1293.2). Two servers both named `hive` collide, the plugin's copy loses, and you get the worst failure shape available — tools keep working so the agent looks healthy, while the channel never arms and no event ever arrives. The plugin must be the sole definition. ROLLBACK: restore the hive and hive-local blocks below into mcpServers, and in wfa2 primary-launcher/configs/spark.json replace --channels and its plugin:hive-channel@wonderforge entry with "--dangerously-load-development-channels", "server:hive-local".
